# file is the one crawlers actually read. The sitemap is generated on every
# build by @docusaurus/plugin-sitemap; submit it once in Search Console and
# this line keeps it discoverable ever after.

Allow: /

# Search results are a client-side view of the index, not content.
Disallow: /search
